steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Madam...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Speak.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Most of Reunion's forces have retreated already.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Madam Ch'en, we're also done here.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Tsk...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: About those Reunion suspects that we rounded up a few days ago...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Have we been able to get any information out of them?

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Does this crossbow look familiar to you?

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: You're able to draw it, aren't you?

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: What's the structure of the ammunition? How does it work?

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: What were you doing in the slums?

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: What were you doing in Lungmen?

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: ...Nothing.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: They won't say a word.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Or perhaps... they just don't know anything.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Like the other Reunion members we defeated, they're probably nothing more than obedient puppets.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...Make them speak.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Use any methods necessary.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I want to know about their squads, their leadership, their strategies, where they're from, and what they plan to do...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Get everything out of them that you can.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I want everything I can get.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Report back to me right away, no matter how insignificant it might seem.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Roger!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Has the L.G.D. ever arrested Reunion members before?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We can't say for sure.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: In the end, it's just speculation.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Get me in touch with Hoshiguma!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: How's the Special Operations Division faring?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Are they still being overwhelmed by a single Infected?

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Reunion seems to have pulled back on their end as well.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Inspector Hoshiguma is worried about a possible trap and is trying to rule out all risks...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hmph... Just a single person...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Who the hell do they think they are, coming and going like that?!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You should already know what your next mission is going to be, Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're going to get Misha back?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: This will be the joint operation.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The L.G.D. will take the lead, while Rhodes Island will be in charge of recon and the assault.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Your mission is complete as long as you can stall Reunion's retreat.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: If we're looking for the enemy... won't we also risk being discovered?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Right now, we also don't have enough support for our recon squad...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: We can't do this on our own.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We should leave this to the professionals.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Franka, help me get in touch with Penguin Logistics.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're going to need another favor from Exusiai and Texas.
